scope.applicability: Observed on the retained MIN 6000TL-XH installation only; this artifact does not change the canonical specification.

observation.source: staging Home Assistant Recorder during the supervised Battery First TOU smoke test
observation.source_database: local staging Recorder database; not redistributed
observation.runtime_mapping: HA growatt_local input register 3023, two words, float scale 0.1, signed flag not set

observed: The HA value is consistent with a negative signed 32-bit inverter value being interpreted as unsigned and scaled by 0.1.
The anomalous values occurred while the battery was charging, when a negative net AC output is physically plausible.
required_follow_up: Capture the raw I3023-I3024 input words directly while the inverter is charging and while it is discharging.
Compare the sign convention with the portal and independent power channels before changing the GII current model.
Only after human review, update the canonical specification and the HA decoder together if the signed interpretation is accepted.

limitations: The Recorder stores the decoded HA state; the original Modbus input words were not retained in this bounded artifact.
The existing GII evidence and overlay currently declare I3023-I3024 unsigned, so the live result is a conflict, not an accepted correction.
No production configuration or entity identity was changed.
